    # The separator row (all 4s) divides two binary masks. Overlay their
    # occupied cells, coloring the union with 3.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 4 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    return [[3 if top[r][c] != 0 or bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(top[r]))]
            for r in range(len(top))]
